name: resy-mcp
description: Resy reservation management for Claude — search venues, book tables, manage reservations and priority notify

resy_email.title: Resy Email (optional)
resy_email.description: Your Resy account email. Leave blank to use the ContextMint Bridge browser extension instead.

resy_password.title: Resy Password (optional)
resy_password.description: Your Resy account password. Leave blank to use the ContextMint Bridge browser extension instead.

resy_auth_token.title: Resy Auth Token (optional override)
resy_auth_token.description: Pre-obtained x-resy-auth-token. Overrides email/password and the ContextMint Bridge path. Power users / CI only.

resy_disable_fetchproxy.title: Disable fetchproxy fallback
resy_disable_fetchproxy.description: Set to '1' to disable the fetchproxy fallback (forces RESY_EMAIL+PASSWORD or RESY_AUTH_TOKEN).

resy_api_key.title: Resy API key (optional pin)
resy_api_key.description: Pin the api key, beating both the key captured from the live site and the compiled-in default. Rotation does not require it: the key is captured and cached automatically.

resy_token_cache.title: Token cache
resy_token_cache.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk token cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

resy_token_file.title: Token cache file
resy_token_file.description: Absolute path for the token cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.resy-mcp/token.json.

resy_api_key_file.title: API-key cache file
resy_api_key_file.description: Absolute path for the api-key cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.resy-mcp/api-key.json. Holds the bare key captured from the live site, which takes precedence over the compiled-in default.

resy_capture_timeout.title: Bridge capture timeout (seconds)
resy_capture_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the signed-in page to make an API call the bridge can read the auth token from. Defaults to 30. Capture resolves on the next matching request, so an idle tab needs a longer window than a busy one.

resy_ws_port.title: fetchproxy bridge port
resy_ws_port.description: Port for the fetchproxy bridge. The whole fleet shares 37149 (the ContextMint Bridge extension dials it), so override only for local development, test isolation, or a hosted bridged registration — this is the variable to name in the registration's bridgePortEnv.

tools.name: resy_get_profile
tools.description: Get the authenticated Resy user's profile

tools.name: resy_list_payment_methods
tools.description: List saved payment methods (id, brand, last_four, is_default)

tools.name: resy_find_slots
tools.description: List available reservation slots at a venue

tools.name: resy_get_venue
tools.description: Get full venue details by id

tools.name: resy_healthcheck
tools.description: Verify the Resy credential and API reachability: reports which of the three mint paths is configured (env token, password login, fetchproxy), then makes one authenticated call.
